items.name: Beginner & Blind Benoni 2026
items.information:
**CubingZA** is excited to announce Beginner & Blind Benoni 2026!! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and pay for your ticket to confirm your entry. Please see Registration Requirements below for instructions and when registration opens.

We will be having the Beginner Events in the morning and Blindfolded Events in the afternoon. There will be a separate Awards' Ceremony after each one so if you can, feel free to stick around for both and witness Total Non-Stop Action...with your eyes open or closed!!


**All New Competitors**
If this is your first time competing, or the first time your child or ward is competing, please ensure to bring with ID (card, book, passport, birth certificate) so that we can verify that the name is spelled correctly, the Date of Birth is correct, and the Nationality is correct.
Please also ensure you have all the puzzles you need to compete - we do not supply puzzles for competitors. You are welcome to ask other competitors if you can borrow their puzzle for a certain event, but there is no guarantee.

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY1MDYzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ccd65f403457dc282c8579d38ca9bea44c3a8e26/636674475_1225483876408329_1643318046908654871_n.jpg)


**Προσοχή:** Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι το Β μέρος σειράς δύο διαγωνισμών. Μπορείτε να συμμετάσχετε **μόνο σε έναν από τους δύο**. 
Τα events 3x3 και 2x2 είναι και στους δύο διαγωνισμούς οπότε διαλέξτε με προσοχή ποια μέρα ή πoιο από τα Skewb, Clock, Blind ή 4x4, Pyraminx  επιθυμείτε.

Μετά τη μεγάλη επιτυχία του πρώτου διαγωνισμού του 2026 που έγινε για πρώτη φορά στο Panellinios Club House, η λαϊκή απαίτηση ήταν να επαναληφθεί ένας διαγωνισμός σύντομα στο ίδιο μέρος! Ελάτε με τους κύβους σας να περάσουμε όμορφες στιγμές με το αγαπημένο μας χόμπι. Σας περιμένουμε στο **Easter Fever Athens Β 2026.**

Αγωνίσματα Β' διαγωνισμού:
* 3x3
* 2x2
* 4x4
* Pyraminx

Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. 

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg)

[Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI)

**Attention:** This competition is Part B of a series of two competitions. You may participate in **only one of the two.**
The 3x3 and 2x2 events are included in both competitions, so choose carefully which day or which of the Skewb, Clock, Blind or 4x4, Pyraminx you would like to compete in.

After the great success of the first 2026 competition, which was held for the first time at the Panellinios Club House, popular demand called for another competition to be organized soon at the same venue! Bring your cubes and join us to enjoy great moments with our favorite hobby. We look forward to seeing you at **Easter Fever Athens B 2026.**

Events of Competition B:
* 3x3
* 2x2
* 4x4
* Pyraminx


Please read the following pages carefully to find all the necessary information.

Note: For a registration to be considered complete, you must complete the registration on the competition’s WCA page **AND** pay the participation fee using your bank card through the Stripe payment platform used by the WCA, as described in the adjacent tabs.

items.name: Tennessee Mini Qualifier 2026
items.information:
**Note:** Competitors under the age of 18 must fill out this [form](https://forms.gle/cFt7i8vmK9yEA7U2A) and be accompanied by an adult parent/guardian at all times.

Join us for a short competition on the same day as [CubingUSA Southeast FMC Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoutheastFMCChampionship2026)! This competition will **not** hold the 3x3x3 speedsolving event, but it is a great way to achieve qualifying times for the Southeast and North American Championship or get some extra solves in for less commonly held events. Southeast FMC Championship will be held from 10AM-2PM at the same location; if you are not competing in FMC, you are not obligated to stay at the competition during those hours. However, if you want to compete in FMC, you must sign up for that competition separately.

Parking is available in the [25th Ave garage](https://www.google.com/maps/place/25th+Avenue+Staff+Garage,+Nashville,+TN+37212/@36.1420785,-86.8090749,1416m/data=!3m2!1e3!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x886466a3758e808d:0x8eefe637f1e59f04!8m2!3d36.1420742!4d-86.8064946!16s%2Fg%2F11x6c4mjbl!5m1!1e1?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDEyOC4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) (parking block reservation info TBD) or in the [2525 West End garage](https://www.google.com/maps/place/2525+West+End+Garage,+2525+US-70S,+Nashville,+TN+37203/@36.1454243,-86.8087472,283m/data=!3m1!1e3!4m6!3m5!1s0x886466bb24608181:0x9e06cb9388908144!8m2!3d36.1456866!4d-86.8086177!16s%2Fg%2F11b6bcy8cs!5m1!1e1?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDEyOC4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) for $3/hour.
